paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) for video generation usually assigns one scalar reward to an entire sampled video. Yet a video is not uniformly flawed: some visual tokens may already satisfy the prompt, whereas others require correction. A scalar reward cannot localize errors, causing optimization to perturb satisfactory tokens while under-targeting the tokens that actually need to change. We introduce Token-Level Video Reinforcement Learning, TVRL, a framework that derives token-level credit from the reward being optimized. Our key insight is that the answer likelihood of a frozen vision-language model provides both signals: its outputs contribute to the video-level reward, while magnitudes of its video-input gradients reveal which generated video tokens most affect that score. We instantiate TVRL in Group Relative Policy Optimization by averaging prompt-derived question rewards into one group-relative advantage and using detached, question-conditioned token-credit maps to reweight dense denoising-transition log-probabilities inside the clipped policy ratio. On VBench-2.0, TVRL achieves an Overall score of 57.69, outperforming the base model by 3.60 points. TVRL also improves matched GRPO baselines across three SDE samplers (SAGE, Flow, and Dance) by 2.68–3.15 points and across four reward models (VideoAlign, VideoScore2, UnifiedReward2, and Qwen3.5-9B) by 1.33–3.15 points.

paragraphs.en: Text-to-video generation ( Wan et al., 2025 ; Kong et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025a ; Polyak et al., 2024 ; Lightricks, 2025 ) has advanced rapidly with diffusion ( Sohl-Dickstein et al., 2015 ; Ho et al., 2020 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ; Ho et al., 2022 ) and flow-matching ( Lipman et al., 2023 ) models. As base models improve, post-training that aligns generated videos with prompts, human preferences, and evaluation criteria has become increasingly important ( Xu et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Xu et al., 2024 ) . Inspired by reinforcement learning for language models ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ; Shao et al., 2024 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2025 ) , recent work adapts Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) ( Shao et al., 2024 ) to video generation ( Liu et al., 2025a ; Xue et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) by converting the deterministic denoising ODE into an SDE sampler, which defines a stochastic policy over latent denoising trajectories. For each prompt, GRPO samples a group of videos, scores each completed trajectory, and updates the generator with group-relative advantages, with no separate value model.

paragraphs.en: Despite this progress, video RL faces a fundamental credit-assignment bottleneck. Training must determine not only whether one trajectory is better than another, but also when and where the reward-relevant evidence appears. A video-level scalar reward can rank completed denoising trajectories, but it cannot indicate which video tokens are responsible for success or failure ( Wu et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Liang et al., 2026 ) ( Figure 2 ). This limitation matters because the evidence for many prompt requirements is confined to a small region or a few frames, for example, whether the requested grand piano is rendered as a piano rather than a generic keyboard ( Figure 1 ), whether a watch case is rose gold, whether the described fireflies appear in the scene at all, or whether the camera pans to the right instead of staying static. Broadcasting the same scalar advantage to every latent token therefore spends update capacity on regions that have nothing to do with the evaluated error. Recent work separates the video-level reward from token credit ( Ni et al., 2026 ) , but derives credits from perceptual features independent of rewards.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展，视频强化学习仍面临一个根本性的信用分配瓶颈。 训练不仅要判断一条轨迹是否优于另一条，还要判断与奖励相关的证据在何时何地出现。 视频级别的标量奖励可以对完整的去噪轨迹进行排序，但无法指出哪些视频 token 是导致成功或失败的原因（Wu et al., 2025b；Wang et al., 2026；Liang et al., 2026）（图 2）。 这一局限之所以重要，是因为许多提示词要求的证据仅局限于一个小区域或少数几帧，例如，所要求的大钢琴是被渲染为钢琴而不是普通的键盘（图 1），手表表壳是否为玫瑰金色，所描述的萤火虫是否真的出现在场景中，或者镜头是向右平移而不是保持静止。 因此，将相同的标量优势广播到每个潜在 token 上，会把更新能力浪费在与所评估错误无关的区域上。 近期的工作将视频级别的奖励与 token 信用分离开来（Ni et al., 2026），但其信用来源于独立于奖励的感知特征。

paragraphs.en: The missing quantity is a routing signal tied to the reward itself. Score gradients provide such a signal because they measure how sensitive an evaluator’s score is to local changes in the video-frame input ( Xu et al., 2023 ; Clark et al., 2023 ; Prabhudesai et al., 2023 ; Prabhudesai et al., 2024 ) . Prior differentiable reward methods typically use these gradients to update the generator directly. In GRPO, we use them differently: after detachment, their magnitudes weight denoising log-probabilities, while the group-relative advantage remains the scalar RL signal. This preserves the clipped policy-gradient structure of GRPO and avoids backpropagating the reward loss through the generator. The remaining requirement is semantic alignment: the score being differentiated must represent the requirement whose credit we want to localize.

paragraphs.en: This score–credit alignment makes the choice of evaluator interface central. Custom video reward models provide differentiable scalar feedback, but a single scalar head does not expose which semantic requirement its gradient should explain ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . We therefore use an evaluator whose score is tied to an explicit video-grounded question, so the reward and the sensitivity map are computed from the same semantic check. Pretrained VLMs ( Qwen Team, 2026 ; Bai et al., 2025 ) offer exactly such an interface: prompt following, physical plausibility, object interaction, and temporal consistency can all be phrased as video-grounded questions, and the teacher-forced likelihood of a reference answer measures whether each check is satisfied. Because every question–answer likelihood is differentiable with respect to the VLM’s video-frame input, a single check provides both a scalar contribution to the rollout objective and a question-conditioned sensitivity map for routing its update. Using a frozen, off-the-shelf evaluator also removes the need for reward-model training and per-check preference labels ( Furuta et al., 2024 ) . This is the central idea of our work: the same semantic check that determines whether a prompt requirement is satisfied also estimates where the resulting policy update should be applied.

paragraphs.en: Building on this observation, we propose TVRL (Token-Level Video Reinforcement Learning), a training framework in which a video policy is evaluated by video-level rewards but updated through explicit token-level credit; the name does not assume that video tokens are discrete actions. We instantiate the framework for text-to-video diffusion with a clipped group-relative objective. For each prompt, we construct binary video-grounded checks and score generated videos by the teacher-forced VLM likelihood of the reference answers. Each check yields two coupled quantities from the same scalar: a question reward given by the likelihood value, and a detached token-credit proxy given by the magnitude of its video-frame-input gradient. The latter measures local sensitivity rather than signed or causal credit. We average the question rewards before group-relative normalization to obtain a single rollout-level advantage shared across checks, and we use each question-conditioned credit map to reweight the dense denoising-transition log-probabilities inside the clipped GRPO surrogate. The shared advantage sets the direction and strength of the update, while the credit maps determine its spatio-temporal allocation. This design preserves group-relative rollout ranking and ratio clipping, and it never backpropagates reward gradients through the generator. Averaging several checks also reduces reliance on any single question. Our contributions are:

paragraphs.en: Alignment of video generators has increasingly moved beyond a single global score toward feedback structured by space, time, or evaluation criterion. Differentiable reward optimization obtains such feedback by backpropagating reward gradients through the decoder and the denoising chain ( Clark et al., 2023 ; Prabhudesai et al., 2023 ; Prabhudesai et al., 2024 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . These gradients encode how sensitive the score is to local video evidence, but using them to update the generator directly requires keeping the reward model, the decoder, and the multi-step denoising graph in memory, and repeated Jacobian products along the stochastic chain can amplify unstable local gradients. Other dense-feedback methods expose localized failures through temporal preference labels, dense captions, rich human or AI feedback, or patch-level reward models ( Wu et al., 2025b ; Krishna et al., 2017 ; Xiong et al., 2024 ; Liang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2025a ) , at the cost of additional annotation or a separately trained localized reward model. Structured alignment systems ( Liang et al., 2026 ) and ViPO ( Ni et al., 2026 ) redistribute a scalar evaluation or GRPO advantage to finer units, yet their allocation maps come from perceptual priors rather than from the check that produced the reward. Recent VLM-based video evaluators instead express prompt requirements as semantic questions rather than task-specific reward heads ( Qwen Team, 2026 ; He et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ) . TVRL uses this interface to couple reward evaluation with token-level credit: teacher-forced answer likelihoods score prompt-level checks, and detached video-frame-input gradients weight the denoising log-probabilities within GRPO. Unlike Diffusion-DRF ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , which also uses structured VLM feedback but backpropagates it through the generator, the VLM gradient here stops at the credit map; unlike scalar GRPO, it changes where the update is applied; and unlike dense-feedback methods, it needs no dense labels or localized reward model.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成器的对齐已日益超越单一的全局分数，转向按空间、时间或评估标准结构化的反馈。 可微奖励优化通过将奖励梯度反向传播经过解码器和去噪链来获得此类反馈（ Clark et al., 2023 ; Prabhudesai et al., 2023 ; Prabhudesai et al., 2024 ; Yuan et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026 ）。 这些梯度编码了分数对局部视频证据的敏感程度，但直接用它们更新生成器需要将奖励模型、解码器和多步去噪图都保存在内存中，且沿随机链反复的雅可比乘积可能放大不稳定的局部梯度。 其他密集反馈方法通过时间偏好标签、密集描述、丰富的人类或 AI 反馈或块级奖励模型来暴露局部失败（ Wu et al., 2025b ; Krishna et al., 2017 ; Xiong et al., 2024 ; Liang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2025a ），但代价是需要额外的标注或单独训练的局部化奖励模型。 结构化对齐系统（ Liang et al., 2026 ）和 ViPO（ Ni et al., 2026 ）将标量评估或 GRPO 优势重新分配到更细的单元，但它们的分配映射来自感知先验，而非来自产生该奖励的检查本身。 近来基于 VLM 的视频评估器则将提示要求表达为语义问题，而非任务特定的奖励头（ Qwen Team, 2026 ; He et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ）。 TVRL 利用这一接口将奖励评估与 token 级信用分配耦合：教师强制下的答案似然对提示级检查进行评分，而分离视频帧输入后的梯度在 GRPO 中为去噪对数概率加权。 与同样使用结构化 VLM 反馈但将其反向传播通过生成器的 Diffusion-DRF（ Wang et al., 2026 ）不同，这里的 VLM 梯度止步于信用图；与标量 GRPO 不同，它改变了更新施加的位置；与密集反馈方法不同，它无需密集标签或局部化奖励模型。

paragraphs.en: GRPO removes the need for a learned value model by sampling multiple outputs for the same prompt and normalizing their rewards within the group, which makes it attractive for large video generators ( Shao et al., 2024 ) . Recent video GRPO methods adapt this formulation to diffusion and flow models by treating denoising as a stochastic policy and defining transition log-probabilities along sampled latent trajectories. Flow-GRPO ( Liu et al., 2025a ) , DanceGRPO ( Xue et al., 2025 ) , and SAGE-GRPO ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) instantiate this framework with different stochastic denoising samplers. All of them optimize a clipped policy-gradient objective, but with a scalar reward they assign one terminal reward to each rollout and apply the resulting group-relative advantage uniformly across denoising steps and latent video tokens. Such a reward indicates whether a video is better than the others in its prompt group, not where the update should concentrate. Our video instantiation of TVRL is complementary to these samplers: it retains the clipped group-relative update and replaces uniform assignment with VLM-gradient token credit that reweights the dense denoising log-probabilities before the policy ratio is formed.

paragraphs.en: We fine-tune HunyuanVideo-1.5 ( Wu et al., 2025a ) on the public SAGE-GRPO prompts ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , keeping the VAE decoder, the text encoder, and the VLM critic frozen. Training rollouts contain 81 frames at × 624 352\!\times\!624 resolution with 20 denoising steps; evaluation videos contain 121 frames at × 864 480\!\times\!864 with 40 steps. We use the Muon optimizer with learning rate 10 − 5 10^{-5} and weight decay 0.01 0.01 on 64 NVIDIA A100 80GB GPUs, with a per-device batch size of 2 and a group size of 4. The default Qwen3.5-9B critic scores five offline-decomposed yes/no checks by teacher-forced answer log-probability. Their average forms the shared group-relative advantage, and their credit maps route it in the policy ratio.

paragraphs.en: Across the tested configurations, TVRL improves over matched GRPO baselines with several stochastic samplers and differentiable evaluators. It raises VBench-2.0 Overall with the SAGE, Flow, and Dance samplers and yields positive gains for all four evaluators tested under SAGE. paragraphs.en: We presented TVRL, a framework that derives token-level credit from the reward being optimized in video reinforcement learning, and instantiated it in GRPO for text-to-video diffusion. Averaged teacher-forced question rewards set the sign and strength of each update through a shared group-relative advantage, and detached VLM gradients set its spatio-temporal allocation inside the clipped policy ratio. On VBench-2.0, TVRL improves over matched GRPO baselines for all four reward models under SAGE (+1.33 to +3.15 Overall) and for all three samplers with Qwen3.5-9B (+2.68 to +3.15), and × 3 3\!\times\!3 spatial credit outperforms both coarser and unsmoothed × 1 1\!\times\!1 credit. TVRL shows a promising direction for video RL: moving from trajectory-level to token-level updates, so that each rollout’s advantage acts on the video tokens that determine its reward. We expect token-level credit to extend to longer videos and other evaluators.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 TVRL，这是一个在视频强化学习从被优化的奖励中推导出词元级信用分配的框架，并将其在文本到视频扩散模型中与 GRPO 结合进行了实例化。 平均的教师强制问题奖励通过共享的组相对优势设定每次更新的符号与强度，而分离的 VLM 梯度则在裁剪的策略比率内部设定其在时空上的分配。 在 VBench-2.0 上，TVRL 在 SAGE 下于全部四个奖励模型上均超越匹配的 GRPO 基线（Overall 提升 +1.33 至 +3.15），在使用 Qwen3.5-9B 时于全部三种采样器上均取得提升（+2.68 至 +3.15），并且 × 3 3\!\times\!3 空间信用分配优于更粗糙的以及未平滑的 × 1 1\!\times\!1 信用分配。 TVRL 展示了视频强化学习的一个有前景的方向：从轨迹级更新转向词元级更新，使每次采样的优势作用于决定其奖励的视频词元上。 我们期待词元级信用分配能够扩展到更长的视频以及其他评估器上。

paragraphs.en: Table A4 examines how much video and semantic evidence the critic uses. Increasing the number of sampled reward frames from 5 to 30 improves Overall from 53.49 to 55.71, with the largest gains in creativity, human action, and physics. paragraphs.en: We fix 12 disjoint pairs of source prompts and two generation seeds per pair, yielding 24 video pairs. Each source contributes 20 uniformly sampled frames, center-cropped to a square and resized to fill an equal-size panel; the crop is fixed and not object-aware. An earlier construction instead letterboxed each full frame into its panel with neutral padding, which left the content in roughly half of the panel area; we report it as a second row on the same pairs and questions. For each pair, we concatenate the panels as A ​ B AB and B ​ A BA and ask separately whether target A A or target B B is present. The questions do not specify positions. This gives 96 real Qwen3.5-9B gradient computations per panel construction of the teacher-forced log-probability of the fixed answer Yes . Unlike the full training question set, this diagnostic uses object-presence checks. Before computing gradients, we review three frames per pair and require each target to be visible in at least two. This qualifies 20 crop-to-fill pairs: one pair contains an ambiguous piano-like object, and in three pairs the fixed crop removes the target from at least two reviewed frames. The letterbox construction qualifies 23 pairs under the same rule. Unqualified pairs are retained in the all-pairs analysis, every prompt-pair group keeps at least one qualified pair, and no pairs are replaced after observing gradients. The construction uses known panel boundaries rather than detector or segmenter masks; each panel nevertheless contains background as well as the target.

paragraphs.en: The reward for a slot is the mean target-answer log-probability over the answer-value tokens in the reference answer. Slot rewards are averaged into the rollout reward before group-relative normalization. Credit weights come from the absolute gradient of each slot reward with respect to the processed VLM video-frame input, normalized across time and space for spatial routing (across time for frame-only routing). The maps remain question-conditioned but share one rollout-level advantage. All slots are evaluated in one teacher-forced sequence; later slots are conditioned on preceding reference tokens, not statistically independent answers. Answer-token predictions from that same forward pass are used only for monitoring: they neither select the fixed reference target nor enter the main reward. Autoregressive free-generation scoring is a separate ablation.

paragraphs.en: This analysis is conditional: it does not establish that a VLM gradient is a perfect causal explanation of video semantics. The gradient is a local, model-dependent sensitivity measure, and its absolute value captures importance rather than sign. The practical claim is that when this sensitivity aligns with prompt-relevant temporal evidence, token credit concentrates the GRPO update on the frames where changes most likely affect the reward.
paragraphs.zh: 本分析是有条件的：它并未确立 VLM 梯度是对视频语义的完美因果解释。 该梯度是一种局部的、依赖于模型的敏感性度量，其绝对值反映的是重要性而非符号。 实际的论点是：当这种敏感性与提示词相关的时间证据一致时，token 信用分配会将 GRPO 更新集中在那些变化最可能影响奖励的帧上。

sents.en: This analysis is conditional: it does not establish that a VLM gradient is a perfect causal explanation of video semantics.
sents.zh: 本分析是有条件的：它并未确立 VLM 梯度是对视频语义的完美因果解释。

sents.en: The gradient is a local, model-dependent sensitivity measure, and its absolute value captures importance rather than sign.
sents.zh: 该梯度是一种局部的、依赖于模型的敏感性度量，其绝对值反映的是重要性而非符号。

sents.en: The practical claim is that when this sensitivity aligns with prompt-relevant temporal evidence, token credit concentrates the GRPO update on the frames where changes most likely affect the reward.
sents.zh: 实际的论点是：当这种敏感性与提示词相关的时间证据一致时，token 信用分配会将 GRPO 更新集中在那些变化最可能影响奖励的帧上。

paragraphs.en: The main-text optimization comparison focuses on the consistent w/o-credit → \rightarrow frame → \rightarrow × 7 7\!\times\!7 → \rightarrow × 3 3\!\times\!3 progression. Figure B1 additionally reports the unsmoothed × 1 1\!\times\!1 control. This extreme does not continue the trend: it underperforms the spatially aggregated variants with Qwen3.5-9B, and its VideoScore2 reward drops sharply, indicating evaluator-dependent optimization instability. A held-out Qwen3.5-9B evaluation is consistent with this observation: × 1 1\!\times\!1 obtains 55.10 Overall, below frame credit (56.47), × 7 7\!\times\!7 (57.08), and × 3 3\!\times\!3 (57.69).

paragraphs.en: The raw VLM-gradient map is a local sensitivity estimate rather than a noise-free causal attribution. Without spatial aggregation, isolated high-frequency responses can survive normalization and assign disproportionate credit to a few latent cells. This lowers the effective number of credited units and can increase update variance, as described by Equation B11 . PPO clipping limits excessive likelihood-ratio contributions but cannot correct a persistently mislocalized routing direction. The more severe VideoScore2 failure suggests that robustness at cell-level resolution also depends on the structure of the evaluator’s reward sensitivity; it implies neither that question-level advantages are required nor that token credit is ineffective.
paragraphs.zh: 原始的 VLM 梯度图是一种局部敏感性估计，而非无噪声的因果归因。 在没有空间聚合的情况下，孤立的高频响应可能在归一化后仍然保留，并将不成比例的信用分配给少数潜在单元。 这降低了被记入信用的单元的有效数量，并可能增加更新方差，如公式 B11 所述。 PPO 裁剪可以限制过大的似然比贡献，但无法纠正持续错误定位的路由方向。 VideoScore2 更严重的失败表明，单元级分辨率下的鲁棒性还取决于评估器奖励敏感性的结构；这既不意味着必须使用问题级优势，也不意味着词元级信用是无效的。

paragraphs.en: Together with the held-out result above, Figure B1 shows that removing spatial aggregation does not extend the improvement obtained by moving from frame-level to spatially aggregated credit. The complementary × 3 3\!\times\!3 versus × 7 7\!\times\!7 residual diagnostic appears in Figure 8 of the main paper, and Figure B2 shows two further examples, with the strongest residuals near the pen barrel and writing region and near the white headband.
